description: This file provides SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) protection helpers for server-side URL fetching, including validation, hostname and IP checks, and logging for blocked attempts.

methods.name: normalizeHostname
methods.description: Converts hostname to lowercase and removes trailing dot for normalization.

methods.name: stripIPv6Brackets
methods.description: Removes brackets from IPv6 addresses enclosed in [].

methods.name: isPrivateIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within private or reserved ranges.

methods.name: isBlockedHostname
methods.description: Determines if a hostname is a blocked cloud metadata endpoint or localhost.

methods.name: isCloudMetadataEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is a cloud metadata endpoint.

methods.name: validateUrlCore
methods.description: Performs core validation of URL string, including protocol, hostname, and IP checks.

methods.name: validateUrlForSSRF
methods.description: Asynchronous validation of URL with DNS resolution and rebinding protection.

methods.name: validateUrlForSSRFSync
methods.description: Synchronous URL validation without DNS checks.

methods.name: isTrustedInternalUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL belongs to the same origin as the web application.

methods.name: sanitizeUrlForLog
methods.description: Redacts sensitive parts of URL for secure logging.

methods.name: logBlockedSSRFAttempt
methods.description: Logs blocked SSRF attempts with sanitized URL and reason.
